Anya (Docs): hey @Leo @Samir — opened a PR to add the new tiered burst credits section and migration notes for quota/dashboard. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823. Quick asks: 1) sanity-check the math in the 'burst allocation' example, 2) confirm SDK header name and example snippet, 3) validate the PromQL for the quota panel. pasted snippets below. PTAL, aiming to merge EOD.

Leo (Eng): skimming now. main thing i noticed: the example uses 'per hour' but the numbers read like 'per minute' — should be units/min.

Samir (Platform): PromQL suggestion: prefer using rate over increase for smoothing in 5m window. e.g. ``sum(rate(request_tokens_total[5m])) by (team)`` divided by quota_limit gauge. also watch for label cardinality.

Maria (Docs): SDK header should be `x-redwood-quota-burst` (we standardized last quarter). i'll add both python and node snippets. also nit: in the yaml example the `window` uses `60s` everywhere but text calls it "1m" — make them consistent.

Anya (Docs): thanks — pushed two small commits: fixed units to "units/min", unified window to `60s`, changed header to `x-redwood-quota-burst`. added a python snippet. deploy preview is up.

docs-bot: deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-4823--docs.redwood.com (build #4823) :white_check_mark:

Leo (Eng): quick look at the yaml and math — the burst_credit calculation example is fine after unit fix. one minor suggestion: show the formula inline, like `burst = floor((quota_rate * window) * burst_multiplier)` so readers get the intuition.

Anya (Docs): good call, added the inline formula and a tiny worked example (numbers). also added this PromQL example to the dashboard panel docs: 
```
# panel: team token consumption as pct of quota
( sum by (team) (rate(request_tokens_total[5m])) / max_over_time(quota_limit[5m]) ) * 100
```
Samir (Platform): that looks reasonable. can we add one sentence about why we use `max_over_time` (handles quota bumps during rollouts)?

Anya (Docs): added sentence. also added a short migration note for Dedicated customers about header differences (old: `x-redwood-burst`, new: `x-redwood-quota-burst`) and a snippet for backwards-compatible proxying.

Maria (Docs): LGTM. i'll do a docs-only pass after lunch for tone.

Leo (Eng): :thumbsup: from eng. feel free to merge once Maria's pass is done.

Anya (Docs): thanks all — merging after Maria checks. will follow up if support tickets show up. :rocket:
